tools.name: fact_check_claim
tools.description: PAID tool ($0.25 USDC via x402, Base). Fact-check a claim against live web sources: the claim is decomposed into sub-claims, sources are fetched live, Jev jurors judge per-source-family entailment with verbatim-quote evidence that must pass an anti-hallucination substring gate, and the verdict is co

tools.name: fact_check_preview
tools.description: Free preview: decompose a claim into sub-claims, fetch the sources live (or search for them), classify each source and group sources into independent families, and show exactly what a paid fact_check_claim would check. No verdict, no jury calls, no payment.

tools.name: fact_check_status
tools.description: Check whether ClaimGate is live, whether the Jev jury is configured, which x402 facilitator is selected, how many receipts are stored, and the paid-check price.

tools.name: fact_check_methodology
tools.description: The full public ClaimGate methodology: coherence formula, source-class weights, verdict thresholds, the anti-hallucination verbatim-quote gate, family independence rules, and honest limits. calibrated:false — thresholds are stated, not fitted.

tools.name: fact_check_receipt
tools.description: Fetch a stored ClaimGate receipt by receipt_id (the sealed record of a paid fact check: sub-claims, sources, per-family verdicts with validated verbatim quotes, coherence, verdict, and payment).
